item.title: Coldcard firmware flaw let attackers reconstruct seed phrases without touching devices, draining $70M in bitcoin from 1,196 wallets.
JPMorgan warned that fading odds for the CLARITY Act weigh on the crypto market outlook, citing regulatory uncertainty for institutions.
EU MiCA took full effect July 1, triggering USDT delistings on European exchanges as the EU Commission opens a regulatory review.
SEC set targets for crypto rules on token offerings, broker-dealer custody and trading venues ahead of Senate CLARITY Act vote.
SEC and CFTC signed an MOU to coordinate digital asset oversight, including joint rulemakings on clearing, margin and trade data.
U.S. regulators proposed Bank Secrecy Act-style KYC requirements for stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act framework.
Stripe, Coinbase, Mastercard, Visa and BlackRock launched Open Standard and a new dollar-pegged stablecoin, Open USD.
BNY began letting institutional clients custody, mint and redeem Circle's USDC through its digital asset platform.
Augustus raised $180M at a $1B valuation to build a federally chartered clearing bank for stablecoin-era payments and settlement.
Crypto hacks totaled $972M in H1 2026, with Q2 the most-hacked quarter on record at 83 incidents, mostly from compromised keys.
Tokenized equity volumes surged 288% to a record $11.3B in Q2 2026 as institutional demand for on-chain securities accelerated.
MiCA's compliance costs are expected to drive a wave of M&A consolidation among European crypto firms.
EU Commission is consulting through Aug. 31 on whether MiCA needs updating as stablecoin and tokenization growth outpaces the law.
The SEC's five-year strategic plan targets accelerated tokenized capital markets and updated rules for blockchain-based securities.
